1453-1477-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-1477-4694-7306.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on the targeted creature.
Repeat from step 1.

687-2034-3062-8130.easyPrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a creature you control.
687-2034-3062-8130.description:
Activate Wall of Roots by putting two -0/-1 counters on it (due to Pir), adding {G}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control.
In response to Tayam's ability, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wall of Roots, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling yourself three cards and returning Wall of Roots from your graveyard to the battlefield with two vigilance counters on it due to Tayam and Pir.
Repeat.
687-2034-3062-8130.notes: This order of operations and the {2} starting mana are necessary because you cannot pay the counter removal cost before sacrificing the creature to Ashnod's Altar, due to the timing sequence of the activated ability rules.

2018-4247-6288.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-5263-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Resolve both Hammerhead abilities from steps 1 and 3
Repeat.

710-728-5617.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4661-7936.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4661-7936.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Dominion Saboteur and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dominion Saboteur trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4661-7936.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3457-4137-7791.description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding two mana of any color
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6149-6798.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6149-6798.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Stirring Bard from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Stirring Bard enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Stirring Bard.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Stirring Bard token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Stirring Bard token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Stirring Bard trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6149-6798.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3249-5111-5147-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

620-2060-2762-5921.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters, Yotian Dissident triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron and Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2104-3227-7631.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Scrivener
When the Scrivener token enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

575-2292-4294-7115.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}
When Etali enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Yedora triggers, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Holding priority, activate Etali by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, exiling cards from the top of each library until each player has exiled a nonland card, and causing you to cast any number of those cards without paying its mana cost.
For each card cast, Toph's second ability triggers once.
Resolve the first Toph trigger, earthbending Etali.
Resolve any remaining triggers, earthbending any other lands you desire. If you do not want to earthbend other lands, target Etali with all remaining triggers.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies, Toph and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, choosing not to return Etali.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Etali from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities from step 11.

2034-4215-5496.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken green creature.
2034-4215-5496.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a nontoken green creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the green creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7229.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ambitious Dragonborn.
When Ambitious Dragonborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4785-6705.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

11-2365-2928-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2365-2928-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Expropriate by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Expropriate.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Expropriate spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Expropriate spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Expropriate and returning the original Expropriate to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Expropriate from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take at least two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your last extra turn.

586-4314-5258-5618-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Pawn of Ulamog and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a creature token
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1912-2246-3657-6726.description:
Cast Ruby either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} due to Bard Class plus commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Ruby by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kogla by paying {G}, returning Ruby from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1912-2246-3657-6726.notes: If Bard Class is level 3, you will also exile your library with the ability to play the exiled cards until end of turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Rite of Passage
with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-1469-3693.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage and Court of Vantress trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1469-3693.notes: You can also control a Rite of Passage token from Court of Vantress and the combo will work the same.

341-2707-5751-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to draw the land.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature that is a Gnome and/or Artificer

2527-2921-4073-4917--75.notablePrerequisites:
Jan Jansen and the additional Gnome or Artificer do not have a +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one additional artifact creature.
2527-2921-4073-4917--75.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature you control except the Gnome or Artificer.
Jan Jansen triggers, causing it and creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jan Jansen.
When Jan Jansen dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Gnome or Artificer.
When the Gnome or Artificer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Jan Jansen and the other Gnome or Artificer, giving a creature -2/-2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 4.

1437-2431.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
1437-2431.description:
Cast Deepglow Skate by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Deepglow Skate spell three times.
Resolve the first Deepglow Skate spell.
When the Deepglow Skate token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
1437-2431.notes: This combo results in infinite copies of the Deepglow Skate spell on the stack, which you can then resolve to infinitely proliferate. This can put infinite indestructible counters on Myojin to infinitely copy any permanent spell(s) you cast in the future.

3858-6008.easyPrerequisites: Junk Jet attached to a creature with power 1 or greater.
3858-6008.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana and control enough other artifacts such that you can activate Junk Jet enough times to cause the creature it is attached to's power to become equal to or greater than 19.
3858-6008.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Junk Jet by paying {3} and sacrificing another artifact, doubling the creature it is attached to's power until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 until the creature with Junk Jet attached has power 19 or greater.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life, and win the game.

1698-2438-2577-3260.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
1698-2438-2577-3260.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B} or 2 life due to K'rrik.
K'rrik triggers, as well as each creature you control's extort ability.
Resolve the first K'rrik trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first extort trigger, causing you to pay {W/B} or 2 life due to K'rrik, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

974-2645-3984-4417.manaNeeded: {1}{B/P}, plus an additional {5}{B/P} available if you do not control a Smaug token
974-2645-3984-4417.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
Umbral Mantle attached to Satsuki.
Satsuki does not have summoning sickness.
974-2645-3984-4417.description:
Activate Satsuki by tapping it, putting a lore counter on There and Back Again.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing a lore counter from There and Back Again and giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve the There and Back Again ability, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token.
If you control two Smaugs, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If you do, the Smaug that died triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
If you made Treasures this way, activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Satsuki.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1298-3716-4280-5231.description:
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying {5}{R}{R}.
Veyran and Ovika each trigger twice.
Resolve both Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve both Ovika triggers, creating eight 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens with haste.
Resolve Fanning the Flames, dealing 2 damage to any target and returning Fanning the Flames to your hand.
Activate Thermopod seven times by sacrificing seven Phyrexian Goblins, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

527-1354-2635.notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
527-1354-2635.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to the greatest power among creatures you control.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying a total of at least {5}{G}{G}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, giving Selvala +7/+7 until end of turn and untapping Selvala.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Repeat.

1987-3075-3277-3448.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1987-3075-3277-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
